Type: narrow bookcase with drawers
Use: displaying books and decor, closed storage; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, coastal, classic
Materials: painted wood with a brushed grain finish, brass ring pulls
Colors: dark navy blue, gold
Shape: tall slim tower, two open shelves with X-shaped back braces, two drawers below with ring pulls, paneled sides, tapered square legs
Feel: refined, nautical, elegant
Goes with: white walls, brass accents, light wood, striped textiles; coastal or traditional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Alan Casual Wood Bookcase, 23", Navy and Gold
product.description: With its lovely washed navy finish and gold hardware, this vertical piece will add beauty to your room as well as a way to keep organized. Two self-close drawers offer roomy storage. Use alone or with the Teal Story entertainment center. 23"W x 18"D x 68"H Hardwood and fiberboard; metal pulls with gold finish Casual transitional style Features two felt-lined drawers and two shelves Assembly in 30-60 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
